plan.title: Plan v{{version}} · {{task}}
plan.empty: The agent wrote no plan text.
plan.earlier: This is v{{version}}, an earlier plan. Plan v{{latest}} waits for your decision.
plan.changedFromYourNote: Changed since v{{version}}, from your note “{{note}}”
plan.changedFromAutomation: Changed since v{{version}}, from automation's note “{{note}}”
plan.noCriteria: The task has no acceptance criteria.
plan.notePlaceholder: Describe the changes plan v{{version}} needs…
plan.changesHint: Request changes needs a note; {{agent}} then writes plan v{{version}}.
plan.approveContinues: Approving lets the run go on.
plan.clearToApprove: Clear the note to approve, or request changes.

limit.title: Raise the limit
limit.groupReason: The tasks run together used their shared budget. Raising this run's own limit doesn't lift it.
limit.newBudget: New token budget for this run
limit.newStepBudget: New budget for {{step}} in this run
limit.newTime: New time limit for this run
limit.continueMidStep: Continuing resumes {{step}} with {{agent}} from checkpoint {{checkpoint}} in the same worktree. The steps after it then run under the new limit.
limit.continueMidStepUnsaved: Continuing resumes {{step}} with {{agent}} in the same worktree, with its work since the last checkpoint. The steps after it then run under the new limit.
limit.continueStep: Continuing resumes {{step}} with {{agent}} from checkpoint {{checkpoint}} under its new budget. The published pipeline keeps its own.
limit.continueStepUnsaved: Continuing resumes {{step}} with {{agent}} under its new budget, with its work since the last checkpoint. The published pipeline keeps its own.
limit.continueNext: Continuing starts the run's next step under the new limit.
limit.noticeTokens: Stopped at the token limit · checkpoint {{checkpoint}}
limit.noticeTime: Stopped at the time limit · checkpoint {{checkpoint}}

removeMeaning.tokens: Remove the limit continues the run with no token limit.
removeMeaning.time: Remove the limit continues the run with no time limit.
removeMeaning.step: Remove the limit continues the run with no budget for {{step}} in this run.

limit.stepNoBudget: No budget of this step was recorded, so there is none to raise here.

noticeBody.one: {{label}} sent the work back to {{target}} once and the pipeline’s retry limit is reached. The run waits for your decision; nothing runs until you choose.
noticeBody.other: {{label}} sent the work back to {{target}} {{count}} times and the pipeline’s retry limit is reached. The run waits for your decision; nothing runs until you choose.

retries.noRouteNoticeBody: {{label}} reported failed when it was asked again, and the pipeline has no step to send the work back to from it. The run waits for your decision; nothing runs until you choose.
retries.unverifiedNoticeBody: {{label}} checked what it could and says below what it could not, and why. Nothing went back to an earlier step and no retry was used. The run waits for your decision; nothing runs until you choose.

unchangedNoticeBody.failed: {{label}} last failed on this same revision, and nothing has changed since, so running it again would find the same. The run waits for your decision; nothing runs until you choose.
unchangedNoticeBody.unverified: {{label}} last ended unverified on this same revision, and nothing has changed since, so running it again would find the same. The run waits for your decision; nothing runs until you choose.
unchangedNoticeBody.ended: {{label}} last ended on this same revision without passing, and nothing has changed since, so running it again would find the same. The run waits for your decision; nothing runs until you choose.

retries.preserved: Changes and messages are preserved on {{branch}}
retries.title: Decide how the run continues
retries.acceptMeaning: {{step}} passes as it is; the steps after it run.
retries.runAgainMeaning: Runs {{step}} again on the same revision, as you ask.

returnEnded.title: Return the work to an earlier step
returnEnded.body: The run reopens at the step you choose, whose agent reads your note; the steps after it run again.

ready.title: Ready for your review
ready.body: Every step of the run passed. Its changes wait for your review.
ready.mergeNoBranch: Merge needs the branch your checkout had when the run started, which this run didn't record.
ready.mergeWaits: Merge waits until the run's worktree is removed.
ready.mergeWaitsPullRequest: Merge waits until the run's pull request is created.
ready.mergeLocalWork: Merge waits while Local integration works in your checkout.
ready.mergeDecision: Merge waits for the decision Local integration asks for in this project.
ready.mergeResolving: Merge waits while Orchester merges into the run's worktree for you to resolve its conflicts.
ready.askUnavailable: Ask agent needs the conversation's composer, which this app doesn't have yet.
ready.reviewUnavailable: Review PR needs a pull request: create one for this run first.

pullRequest.noConnection: Create pull request needs a usable GitHub connection: link the project's repository and check gh in Connections.
pullRequest.noRemote: Create pull request needs a GitHub remote: the project folder has no origin on GitHub.
pullRequest.wrongAccount: Signed in as {{active}}, expected {{expected}}. Pull requests can't be created until they match; Orchester never switches gh accounts.
pullRequest.missingScope: Missing scope: repo. Run gh auth refresh -h {{host}} -s repo in a terminal, then try again.
pullRequest.noBranch: Create pull request needs the branch your checkout had when the run started, which this run didn't record.
pullRequest.open: This run's branch already has open pull request #{{number}}.
pullRequest.waits: Create pull request waits until git is done with this run's other work.
pullRequest.openedDraft: Pull request #{{number}} opened as a draft.

failure.signInTitle: git couldn't sign in to {{host}} to push {{branch}}
failure.signIn: Run gh auth setup-git or sign in to git in a terminal, then retry. Orchester doesn't change git config.
failure.rejected: git said: {{reason}}. Bring the branch up to date with {{remote}}, then try again.
failure.gitMissing: git was not found. Install git or add it to the PATH, then try again.
failure.gitStopped: git stopped before it pushed the branch. Try again.
failure.noCommits: GitHub found no commits on {{branch}} that {{base}} doesn't have, so there is nothing to review.
failure.ghTitle: gh couldn't open the pull request
failure.unreachable: GitHub couldn't be reached. The branch was pushed; try again once GitHub can be reached.
failure.troubled: GitHub is having trouble. The branch was pushed; try again in a moment.
failure.rateLimited: GitHub's rate limit holds requests back. Try again after it resets.
failure.notSignedIn: gh is not signed in to {{host}}. Run gh auth login in a terminal, then try again.
failure.noAccess: The signed-in account can't open pull requests on this repository. Ask its owner for access, then try again.
failure.ghFailed: gh couldn't open the pull request. The app's log has the details.
failure.notReady: Only the task's latest run, once every step passed, can have a pull request.
failure.alreadyOpen: This run's branch already has an open pull request.

merged.alreadyMerged: {{branch}} already held the run's work at {{time}}.

left.nothing: Its worktrees and merged branches were removed.
left.branches: Its branches {{branches}} stay: their commits are not merged.
left.mergedBranches: Its worktrees were removed; {{branches}} is still there, its commits merged.
left.worktreeOne: Its worktree stays: it has changes that are not committed.
left.worktreeOther: {{count}} of its worktrees stay: they have changes that are not committed.

ready.anotherMerge: Merge waits until another run's merge in this project is done.

resolve.title: Resolve the conflicts
resolve.opensNamed: Merges {{branch}} into the run's worktree and opens it with its conflicting files in {{program}}.
resolve.opensVsCode: Merges {{branch}} into the run's worktree and opens it with its conflicting files in VS Code.
resolve.opensFolder: Merges {{branch}} into the run's worktree and opens its folder. VS Code was not found, so the conflicting files are not opened in an editor.
resolve.noEditor: No editor was found on this computer: install VS Code's code command, or name your editor in ORCHESTER_EDITOR.
resolve.noWritingStep: No agent step of this run may write in its worktree, so no agent can resolve the conflicts.

resolving.title: Resolving the conflicts with {{branch}}
resolving.body: Orchester merged {{branch}} into the run's branch in its worktree, {{path}}. Resolve the conflicts there and save the files, then continue.
resolving.openedNamed: The worktree and its conflicting files opened in {{program}}.
resolving.openedVsCode: The worktree and its conflicting files opened in VS Code.
resolving.openedFolder: The worktree's folder opened. Open the conflicting files in your editor.
resolving.personOnly: Window input does not start an editor: open the worktree in your editor yourself.
resolving.editorFailed: The editor did not start: open the worktree in your editor yourself.
resolving.openYourself: Open the worktree in your editor to resolve the conflicts.
resolving.resolvedWithMarkers: Resolved · conflict markers are still in its text
resolving.unmergeable: Git can't merge it · keep a side
resolving.deletedByBase: {{branch}} deleted it · the run changed it
resolving.deletedByRun: The run deleted it · {{branch}} changed it

ready.noChecks: No step ran after the work was made.

planLimit.noticeBody: The CLI refused {{step}}'s next turn: account {{account}} reached its plan limit, which resets {{time}}. {{agent}}'s session is kept in {{account}}'s folder.
planLimit.noticeBodyNoReset: The CLI refused {{step}}'s next turn: account {{account}} reached its plan limit, and did not say when it resets. {{agent}}'s session is kept in {{account}}'s folder.
planLimit.title: Continue this run
planLimit.waitDetail: At {{time}} Orchester resumes {{agent}}'s own session on {{account}}, where it stopped. Later steps stay on their own accounts.
planLimit.waitDetailNoReset: The CLI did not say when {{account}}'s limit resets. Try again later to resume {{agent}}'s own session on {{account}}, where it stopped.
planLimit.otherDetail: A new {{agent}} session on {{connection}} starts from checkpoint {{checkpoint}}; the stopped session's conversation stays with {{account}}.
planLimit.noOther: No other {{cli}} connection runs on another account that can start now. Add one with another account in Connections.
planLimit.otherNote: Only connections of the same CLI on other accounts are offered. The step's code and brief then go to that account's provider.
planLimit.waitNote: Until then the run stays stopped and holds no agent slot. You can change the choice at any time.
planLimit.waitNoteShort: Until then the run stays stopped and holds no agent slot.
planLimit.waitConfirmed: Waiting: Orchester continues the run at {{time}} by itself and holds no agent slot until then. You can still continue now on another account.
planLimit.waitingTitle: Waiting for {{account}}'s plan limit · starts at {{time}}
planLimit.waitingBody: Run {{run}} starts {{step}} on {{connection}}, whose account has used up its window. It holds no agent slot while it waits.
planLimit.tryNowNote: Starts it on {{account}} once; if the limit still holds, the run waits again.
planLimit.startNote: This run only: the profile keeps {{connection}}. Later steps wait for their own accounts the same way.
planLimit.accountsStopped: {{agent}} · account {{account}} · stopped at its plan limit
